bidkv_break.scope: Ordinary choices have no primary-output trigger field. Same-step and previous REGULAR_COMMIT output releases are observational relations, not causal ancestry. Later ordinary actions after its own release are separate Q1 opportunities, not spare-follow-up recursion. An async load receipt is admission, not transfer completion.

Later ordinary actions after its own release are separate Q1 opportunities, not spare-follow-up recursion. An async load receipt is admission, not transfer completion.

bidkv_current_guard.scope: Ordinary choices have no primary-output trigger field. Same-step and previous REGULAR_COMMIT output releases are observational relations, not causal ancestry. Later ordinary actions after its own release are separate Q1 opportunities, not spare-follow-up recursion. An async load receipt is admission, not transfer completion.

limitations: A current request output in the guard step proves local progress, not a whole-request benefit.
A displaced victim's later pause and completion are observed costs, not a same-state causal estimate of the guard.
A missing running readmission or later token time leaves that interval unknown; no whole gap is automatically called queue wait.
One seen-input serial triplet is not statistical or new-input confirmation.
